Firstlight 0.2.12
Friend requests and Bump now share one consistent action button on profiles. Requests go straight to Requested, and Bump uses its animation without an extra sent message.
Clearer error dialogs keep your original action available. If a response is lost, Firstlight checks what happened before offering another send.
Loading appears only after 250 ms, so quick actions finish without a flashing spinner. Failed sections can be retried independently, and profile and group edits are preserved when saving fails.

Firstlight 0.2.11
Profiles opened from leaderboards now consistently show basic profile information and total computer activity.
App, agent and music sharing remain independent. Restores the existing privacy settings and correctly applies the onboarding sharing shortcuts without changing their appearance.
Improves privacy enforcement across profiles, rankings and friend requests.

Privacy and leaderboard fixes
- Join the global leaderboard explicitly in Settings > Privacy. Participation is off by default. - Leaderboard profiles now open with the activity their owners chose to share and a working friend request action. - Leaving removes you from global people and app rankings and revokes profile access for people outside your circle. - Fixed privacy gaps in older API responses, cached profile access and invitation details.
